title: The Fig Tree Coffee Art & Music Lounge
venue_description:
The Fig Tree Coffee Art & Music Lounge - Roseville Community Hub

The Fig Tree Coffee Art & Music Lounge is a creative community space located at 217 Vernon Street in the heart of downtown Roseville California. This unique venue blends specialty coffee art and live music into a welcoming atmosphere that serves as both a neighborhood coffee shop and emerging music venue. The Fig Tree moved to this location in December 2022 and has become a beloved gathering place for local artists musicians and coffee enthusiasts.

The Fig Tree Mission

The Fig Tree operates as an artist-friendly venue designed to support local musicians and creative expression. The owners and staff are deeply committed to creating a space where people feel welcome to relax socialize express themselves artistically and enjoy quality music in an intimate setting. It is not just a coffee shop but a destination for creativity community and connection.

Live Music and Entertainment

Live music programming runs Tuesday through Friday evenings from 6pm to closing featuring the best local talent in the greater Sacramento area. Saturday nights host the beloved Open Mic Night from 6pm to 9pm with early sign-ups at 5pm. The venue welcomes all genres and skill levels from acoustic covers to experimental original music. A guitar is available in the space and the supportive community makes it feel like home for performers.

The Coffee and Beverages

The Fig Tree exclusively serves Naked Coffee beans in a variety of specialty drinks. The menu features creative offerings like the Mocha Hollander with Hollander dark chocolate Ibarra chocolate espresso and milk as well as signature drinks like the Mocha Thai with vegan white chocolate. Espresso-based drinks lattes cappuccinos cortados and other coffee preparations are made with care. The tea selection includes creative blends like Black Mango Tea David Bowie Tea and other house specialties. Non-coffee beverages and fresh squeezed lemonade are also available.

Food and Pastries

Freshly baked pastries made daily including gluten-free options. Popular items include peach muffins lemon poppyseed cake peanut butter cookies and other sweet treats. Simple light breakfast and snack options available.

Creative Atmosphere

The space features comfortable seating with couches round tables for groups bar seating to watch baristas and smaller square tables. A basement area is available for private meetings when reserved. Beautiful local artwork covers the walls. A community painting easel encourages creative contributions. Free street parking and a free parking garage behind the shop provide convenient access. Power sources throughout the space for laptops and devices.

Community Impact

The Fig Tree has become a vital community gathering place attracting diverse crowds from artists to students to professionals. The friendly knowledgeable staff is known for exceptional customer service and genuine warmth. The venue has earned a 4.7 out of 5 rating with reviewers praising the quality coffee creative atmosphere and supportive community. It is described as a true asset to Roseville and a place where people feel at home.

title: The Strum Shop
venue_description:
The Strum Shop - Roseville's Acoustic Music Institution

The Strum Shop is a family-owned acoustic musical instrument store and community music hub located at 209 Vernon Street in downtown Roseville California. Established in May 2012 by Stu Herreid and Dan Elliott the shop has become a vital gathering place for musicians and music enthusiasts in the greater Sacramento region.

Store Specialty

The Strum Shop specializes in acoustic instruments including ukuleles guitars banjos mandolins and dulcimers. The shop carries a full line of instruments along with a variety of other curious and unique instruments. The motivation for opening the store was to support the rapidly growing community of ukulele players in the greater Sacramento area. The shop encourages a hands-on approach with customers invited to grab an instrument off the wall and play.

Community Music Programming

The Strum Shop hosts numerous music events throughout each month including workshops classes concerts and seminars. The venue serves as home base for multiple music clubs and gatherings creating a vibrant community for acoustic musicians. Regular groups include Uke University River City Ukulele Orchestra Songwriters Circle Acoustic Guitar Club Irish Slow Circle Bluegrass Jam Banjo Ukulele Club Baritone Ukulele Club and River City Dulcimers. The Bluegrass Jam meets on the fourth Thursday of each month welcoming all skill levels.

Music Education

The Strum Shop maintains a dedicated full-time teaching staff offering private lessons every day of the week and group lessons on various days. The instructors work with all skill levels from beginning students to advanced musicians. The shop creates a welcoming and supportive learning environment that encourages musical growth and community connection.

Instrument Services

Full-time in-house repair technician available for instrument maintenance and repairs. Partnerships with several outside luthiers for more extensive repair work. Instrument rentals available for students and musicians. New and used instruments in stock with knowledgeable staff to assist customers.

Atmosphere and Community

The Strum Shop is more than just an instrument retailer - it is a gathering space for the acoustic music community. The shop emphasizes hands-on engagement and welcomes musicians of all skill levels. Regular customers develop deep connections with staff and other musicians creating a close-knit community. The venue is a cultural anchor in downtown Roseville supporting local musical talent and acoustic music traditions.
